requests.criterion: If tire pressure is below 40 psi, provide directions to the nearest tire service center.
requests.delivery_check: The assistant did not provide directions; it said no action was needed.

evidence.quote: kindly provide me with directions to the nearest tire service center
No action is needed at this moment since your tire pressure is currently above 40 psi.

requests.reason: The condition was met, but the assistant claimed otherwise and did not give the requested directions.
requests.state_check: Tool data show all tires below 40 psi, so the condition was met.
requests.tool_comparison: Observed tire pressures 35, 35, 32, and 32 psi are all < 40 psi, so the assistant's 'above 40 psi' claim is wrong and the conditional request should have triggered directions.
